It is not asking too much that the President be law abiding, just like everyone else, and is held accountable when he/she breaks the law.  It is not asking too much that the President is expected to be truthful.  This is not an unreasonable request.

It is not asking too much that our elected officials represent us, instead of dark money interests.  This is just NOT too much to ask. We see elected officials profiting off of their positions, profiting off of concentration camps that they helped set up, profiting off of a war that they allow to continue - a war that everyone agrees should never have been started.  We see them profiting off of selling our public lands, when we have clearly stated we do not want that.  I do not think it is too much to ask to have elected officials that work for their constituents, instead of spending their time lining their own pockets by making immoral and highly questionable policy decisions.  And while we are thinking about what we do want, what we do deserve - I believe we deserve elected officials who are honest and speak truthfully and plainly;  not all the double speak we are seeing out of Washington these days.  We want strong leaders who can take responsibility for their actions, not weaklings who try to blame others for their own blunders.  I think this is a very reasonable request, and I do believe we are overdue for this type of new leadership.
